name: RC–B10–0218/2024 – Motion for a resolution (text as a whole)
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the continued repression of civil society and independent media in Azerbaijan and the cases of Dr Gubad Ibadoghlu, Anar Mammadli, Kamran Mammadli, Rufat Safarov and Meydan TV
part_text:
The European Parliament is asking Azerbaijan to stop cracking down on journalists, activists and critics. It calls for the release of people it says are held on made-up political charges, including Dr Gubad Ibadoghlu, Anar Mammadli, Kamran Mammadli, Rufat Safarov and Meydan TV journalists. It wants the European Union to sanction Azerbaijani officials blamed for rights abuses, and to make any partnership deal with Azerbaijan, including on energy, depend on respect for basic rights. This is an opinion; it does not itself change any law.

- The Parliament asks the EU to sanction named Azerbaijani officials and to suspend the 2022 energy partnership.
- It affects Azerbaijan's government, jailed activists and journalists, and EU-Azerbaijan relations.
- Next, the resolution goes to EU governments, the Commission and Azerbaijan's authorities; they decide whether to act.
